description: Spencer Anderson, a 24-year-old resident of Clarkston, Michigan, was arrested on February 26, 2026 and charged with three felony counts of malicious destruction of police property. Waterford Township police alleged that several automatic license-plate-reader cameras had been broken from their mounts and smashed, and that one reader captured the suspect vehicle while nearby business surveillance recorded a person striking two cameras with a blunt object. Anderson was arraigned in the 51st District Court on February 27 and released on a $500 cash bond. Police estimated the damage at approximately $10,000 and announced that they would seek restitution. No conviction or custodial sentence has been verified, and available sources do not conclusively establish Anderson's personal political motive.
